# INDUS Web Agency

> Outbound telecommunications software: Google Voice auto dialers, dialer CRMs, AI calling, plus custom software studio.

## Primary niche
- Outbound telecom for sales, dispatch, and call centers
- Google Voice auto dialers (DOM starter, multi-slot, AI solo, enterprise AI multi-slot)
- Telecom CRM taxonomy (14 types) and custom CRM builds
- US and Canada geo hubs
